info.title: Project TAP - Tap & Pay API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API documentation for Project TAP — an automated card payment, terminal processing, merchant settlement, and user wallet system.

### Authentication & Testing
1. **Login**: Authenticate at `POST /v1/loginauth` using your username/email and password.
2. **Authorize**: Copy the `access_token` from the login response and click the **Authorize** button (or set Bearer token in Scalar/Swagger UI).
3. **Test**: Click **Try it out** on any endpoint to send live requests directly to the backend.
